bust.rule: first equity-curve bar <= 0.1 x start; trades split by entry time

dirs.cache_extra: research cache (--cache-extra), used only for symbols the primary lacks

costs.exchange_rules: legacy floor (BT02 off: no step / minQty); not execution-realistic

definitions.funding: gross - fees - net (the bar-loop funding charge)
definitions.gross: price P&L after slippage, before fees and funding
definitions.mae_r: APPROXIMATE: worst bar extreme over [entry bar, exit bar] vs entry, in stop-distance R (exit bar may include movement after the exit)
definitions.max_dd_equity: max drawdown of the bar equity curve (fraction)
definitions.max_dd_r: max drawdown of cumulative trade R in exit order
definitions.mfe_r: best price on the backtest path (p.best) vs entry, in stop-distance R
definitions.regime: BTCUSDT close vs 4h EMA200 on the last closed candle before the entry fill

purpose: bounded breadth candidate run (development window only; not evidence for promotion)
